title: Off-base doctor asks 'had they let you see the alien bodies yet'

tellings.quote: goes let me ask you something um had they let you see the alien bodies yet

plain: A doctor off the base near Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio once asked him, out of nowhere, "had they let you see the alien bodies yet." John Blitch, a scientist who worked with DARPA, the Pentagon's advanced research agency, tells Michels this happened to him, and he takes the question as a sign that locals assumed the base held bodies.
